recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, crowded party scene rendered in a stylized airbrush aesthetic, featuring a wall of subwoofers as a backdrop and vibrant, overlapping figures in motion, topped with heavy, chrome-effect graffiti typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Dense crowd of figures in the foreground against a grid of circular speakers
High-contrast chrome gradients in typography against a warm yellow background
Dynamic, elongated character proportions conveying rhythmic movement
Heavy black outlines defining all forms against saturated color fills
coreInvariants: Airbrush-style shading with visible grain and soft gradients
Chrome or metallic texture on large display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central group of dancing figures occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, metallic display text at the top and the grid of black circular speakers in the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the bold header text down through the rhythmic curves of the dancing figures, following the diagonal limbs.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded and 'busy' to reflect a high-decibel environment.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Cyan and Magenta (clothing and text gradients)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across the palette with extreme value contrast between black outlines and bright highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Primary focus on cyan, yellow, and black

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended sans-serif and graffiti-style bubble letters
letterConstructionRules: Internal horizontal gradients simulating chrome reflection
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numbers are stylized with the same weight and chrome effect as letters
Lower-right corner features a secondary, more fluid graffiti tag style
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacking heavy, metallic display fonts with smaller, hand-drawn graffiti tags.
graphicDevices: Starburst call-out sticker in the bottom left

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, blocky structure of the header text.
Matches the middle and bottom text styles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an airbrushed illustration of a crowded dance floor with stylized people in 90s streetwear. The background is a wall of black subwoofers on a yellow-to-white gradient grid. Use thick black outlines and vibrant saturated colors.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-wide display text at the top with a cyan-to-white horizontal gradient and a yellow outline. Add a second layer of bubble-style graffiti text in the middle with a blue-to-white chrome effect. Place a yellow starburst sticker in the bottom left corner.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a horizontal chrome gradient?
Are the figures outlined in thick black ink?
Is the background a grid of speakers?
Is the color palette dominated by yellow and cyan?

adjustableVariables: Number of speakers in the grid
mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid likenesses
Unique graffiti tags to avoid existing logos
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is legible as a real brand name
Check that the airbrush texture is consistent across the image
Verify the chrome effect has a clear horizontal horizon line
Confirm the starburst sticker has a hand-drawn quality
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [90s airbrush illustration] + [wall of subwoofers] + [chrome graffiti typography] + [saturated primary color palette].
